description: Machine-readable mandates for the nine reviewers. question = the single question each role answers; bias_shield = what the role must not do; atlas_field = the regime_nodes.jsonld fields the role maps to (values, not invented keys). This is a data registry, NOT a JSON Schema.

cartographer.question: What is claimed, on which premises, in which regime/phase, and which atlas nodes does it touch?

provenance.question: Do source, version, DOI, ledger status and local/global anchoring match?

formalist.question: Is the mathematics valid under the model's OWN premises?

paradigm_critic.question: Where do borrowed measures, instruments, coordinate choices and limit-assumptions enter?
paradigm_critic.bias_shield: Established physics is not an unlabelled answer key.

falsifier.question: What is the simplest test against the RAW SIGNAL, independent of intervening cosmological model assumptions?
falsifier.bias_shield: Never the standard model's interpretation as ground truth.

alternative_paradigm.question: Which paradigms (LCDM, MOND, EFT, EFC) can generate the same observable, under which premises, with which measurement chains?
alternative_paradigm.bias_shield: Symmetric — no model is the default truth.

measurement_proxy.question: Where is every step of raw-signal to instrument to reduction to proxy to observable to interpretation?

reproducer.question: Can the code/data/measurement chain be regenerated; checksums; determinism?
reproducer.bias_shield: None — this is the empirical gate.

meta_reviewer.question: Synthesise without voting; empirical test outranks consensus; propose status.

human_gate.description: The only party that disposes. Agents propose; the human disposes.
